searchText: Hey there people! Does anybody here have strong opinions on decentralized/shared sequencing? Or would be willing to give some thought on a sequencing proposal (outlining a basic architecture and interfaces that we could get agreement on) later in August?

excerpts.author: norswap
excerpts.content:
Hey there people!
Does anybody here have strong opinions on decentralized/shared sequencing?
Or would be willing to give some thought on a sequencing proposal (outlining a basic architecture and interfaces that we could get agreement on) later in August?
